comments.text: 4.	Definition: In this task, you are given a text of the patient's record and cancer diagnosis. Your job is to identify the clinical stage of the cancer and generate the treatment regimen.

Input: A 34 year old man presents to the clinic with generalised lymphadenopathy, night sweats, fever and weight loss. He has noticed that the swelling in his neck become tender when he drinks alcohol. After workup and lymph node biopsy, NAME_1’s lymphoma was diagnosed. PET scan shows the involved lymph nodes are present on both sides of the diaphragm but do not involve any other organs.
